display.title: Terrible Toothache
display.question: What time of day is it, do you think? How do you know?
display.questionZh: 你觉得现在是什么时间？你是怎么知道的？
display.text:
What time of day is it, do you think? How do you know?

Good morning, Mr. Croft.
Good morning, nurse.
I want to see the dentist, please.
Do you have an appointment?
No, I don't.
Is it urgent?
Yes, it is.
It's very urgent.
I feel awful.
I have a terrible toothache.
Can you come at 10 a.m. on Monday, April 24th?
I must see the dentist now, nurse.
The dentist is very busy at the moment.
Can you come at 2 p.m. ?
That's very late.
Can the dentist see me now?
I'm afraid that he can't, Mr. Croft.
Can't you wait till this afternoon?
I can wait, but my toothache can't!

display.bodyTextZh:
早上好，克罗夫特先生。
早上好，护士。
我想去看牙医，请。
您有预约吗？
不，我没有。
这很紧急吗？
是的，很紧急。
这件事非常紧急。
我感觉糟透了。
我牙疼得非常厉害。
你能于4月24日星期一上午10点来吗？
我现在必须去看牙医了，护士。
牙医现在非常忙。
你能下午2点来吗？
那已经太晚了。
牙医现在可以见我了吗？
恐怕他不行，克罗夫特先生。
你就不能等到今天下午吗？
我可以等待，但我的牙痛却无法忍受！
